title: Strong conservation of spacer lengths in NrdR repressor DNA binding sites
authors: Saher Shahid; Mateusz Balka; Daniel Lundin; Daniel O. Daley; Britt-Marie Sjöberg; Inna Rozman Grinberg
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NrdR阻遏蛋白与DNA结合位点间隔长度的保守性，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但以实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: The ribonucleotide reductase-specific repressor NrdR, from the human pathogens Listeria monocytogenes and Streptococcus pneumoniae , form tetramers that bind to DNA when loaded with dATP and ATP. If loaded with only ATP they form different oligomeric complexes that cannot bind to DNA. The DNA binding site in L. monocytogenes is a pair of NrdR boxes separated by 15-16 bp, whereas in Streptococcus pneumoniae the NrdR boxes are separated by 25-26 bp. However, Streptococcus pneumoniae NrdR binds stronger to the related Streptococcus thermophilus binding sites with NrdR boxes separated by 15-16 bp. This observation triggered a comprehensive binding study of four NrdRs from L. monocytogenes, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Escherichia coli and Streptomyces coelicolor to a series of synthetic dsDNA fragments where the NrdR boxes were separated by 12-27 bp. All four NrdRs bound well to NrdR boxes separated by 14-17 bp, and also to NrdR boxes separated by 24-27 bp. The worst binding occurred when NrdR boxes were separated by 20 bp. The in vitro results were confirmed in vivo in E. coli for spacer distances 12-27 bp. We conclude that NrdR repressors bind most efficiently when there is an integer number of DNA turns between the center of the two NrdR boxes.
abstract_zh: 来自人类病原体单核细胞增生李斯特菌（Listeria monocytogenes）和肺炎链球菌（Streptococcus pneumoniae）的核糖核苷酸还原酶特异性阻遏蛋白NrdR，在负载dATP和ATP时形成四聚体并结合DNA。若仅负载ATP，它们则形成不同的寡聚复合物，无法结合DNA。在单核细胞增生李斯特菌中，DNA结合位点是一对间隔15-16 bp的NrdR盒，而在肺炎链球菌中，NrdR盒间隔25-26 bp。然而，肺炎链球菌NrdR对相关的嗜热链球菌（Streptococcus thermophilus）结合位点（NrdR盒间隔15-16 bp）结合更强。这一观察引发了一项综合结合研究，涉及来自单核细胞增生李斯特菌、肺炎链球菌、大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）和天蓝色链霉菌（Streptomyces coelicolor）的四种NrdR，对一系列合成双链DNA片段（NrdR盒间隔12-27 bp）进行测试。所有四种NrdR均能良好结合间隔14-17 bp的NrdR盒，也能结合间隔24-27 bp的NrdR盒。当NrdR盒间隔20 bp时，结合最差。体外结果在大肠杆菌中通过间隔距离12-27 bp的体内实验得到证实。我们得出结论，当两个NrdR盒中心之间存在整数个DNA螺旋圈数时，NrdR阻遏蛋白结合效率最高。
